covered_report_window: Thursday, November 5, 2026 after the U.S. market close through Friday, November 6, 2026 before the U.S. market open.
market_context_summary: An AI-led risk-off move had the S&P 500 down about 3.8% and QQQ down about 5.6% intraday, while Friday's 8:30 a.m. ET U.S. jobs report adds macro gap risk before the open.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Mall NOI, occupancy and rent momentum support another guide-positive quarter if financing costs stay contained.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: NOI, occupancy and retailer sales sustain upper-end FFO.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Higher interest cost or softer consumer tone blocks a raise.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options priced about 4.8% on an expiration extending beyond the event.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Whisper above consensus; operating evidence stronger than revision signal.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A roughly 94% benefit ratio and Star Ratings pressure leave the guide vulnerable despite strong premium growth.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Loss near $1.03 on about $40.46B revenue; focus is benefit ratio and 2026 guidance.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Utilization improves and pricing/benefit design protects the guide.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Medical costs or Star remediation weaken the earnings path.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied-move snapshot used; managed-care news flow is crowded.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus reflects a seasonal loss; operating-cost pressure remains the larger issue.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A full quarter of Coterra contribution, Delaware output and cost efficiencies support upside at a discounted valuation.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $1.24 EPS and $7.33B revenue, with production and synergy delivery decisive.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Output, unit costs and synergies beat while capex stays controlled.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Integration friction or capex absorbs the commodity benefit.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options priced roughly 5.7% through the report window.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Analyst stance is constructive; valuation is below the peer group.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Mid-single-digit revenue contraction and weak North American demand can outweigh gross-margin repair.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About breakeven EPS on $1.23B revenue, roughly 8% lower year over year.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Margin repair, inventory control and a maintained guide clear a low bar.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Demand weakness forces another revenue-guide cut.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Low share price and a reset bar create material squeeze risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Six of the last eight EPS reports beat, increasing less-bad relief risk.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: High gold and silver prices plus expected production growth support cash-flow upside, but estimate cuts temper conviction.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Roughly $0.93 EPS and $806M revenue; attributable production expected up about 11.5%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Realized prices and production lift cash flow above the revised bar.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Lower gold sales volume or cost/timing issues confirm estimate cuts.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Commodity exposure is the main positioning driver; no clean event-only option read used.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: EPS estimates fell about 17% over 60 days, lowering the bar but flagging caution.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Broadband losses and a downward EPS revision can outweigh mobile growth and a compressed valuation.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $10.06 EPS on $13.48B revenue; EPS consensus fell about 1% in 30 days.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Losses narrow and mobile additions validate convergence economics.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Subscriber erosion persists and capex/free cash flow disappoint.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Very low valuation and de-risking make a squeeze plausible.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: EPS was revised lower; revenue is expected to decline about 1.4%.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Recent 20% sales growth and solid margin execution favor upside if demand and distribution trends hold.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $0.30 EPS on roughly $2.55B revenue.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: International and core Monster demand stay strong while margins hold.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Volume, FX or freight/distribution costs slow the earnings cadence.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Moderate valuation after the split; no reliable event-only implied move used.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Estimate changes were slightly positive over 30 to 90 days.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Fundraising and fee-bearing-capital growth support fee-related earnings, with a presentation change adding modest comparability risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $0.46 EPS and $1.59B revenue; focus is fundraising and fee-related earnings.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: AI/infrastructure fundraising and fee growth exceed the bar.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Slower realizations or weaker fundraising offset base-fee growth.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The stock sold off with the market, reducing some pre-event crowding.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Prior EPS beats and 12% base-management-fee growth support the setup.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: After a dramatic rerating, vaccine sales and cash burn must validate the optimism before next week's analyst day.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About a $1.10 loss and $890M revenue; Q2 guidance targeted up to 10% 2026 revenue growth.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Seasonal vaccine sales and cash discipline beat while pipeline tone improves.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Revenue or year-end cash misses expose the rerating.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The stock has moved from a $22.28 52-week low to above $200, making positioning highly unstable.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Evidence is mixed: operating-cost guidance improved, but pipeline and sales timing dominate.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A cautious sequential revenue bar and new coverage support upside if Signatera volume and pricing stay strong, but the premium multiple raises reversal risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $707M revenue and a $0.28 loss; full-year consensus is near the top of guidance.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Volume, pricing and cash flow support another guide raise.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Sequential normalization or competitor traction dents the high bar.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The stock fell sharply into the event, reducing crowding but not valuation sensitivity.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Analyst targets rose, but the Street already expects strong full-year revenue.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Q3 bookings guidance and upward estimate revisions support a mild upside edge, but a premium valuation and consumer sensitivity cap conviction.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $2.85 EPS and $4.75B revenue; prior guidance called for 15%-17% revenue growth and nights above 10%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Nights and bookings beat, take rate holds and Q4 tone stays constructive.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Slower nights, weaker take rate or cautious holiday guidance sinks a good quarter.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options priced roughly 7.5%-7.8% before the report.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Current-quarter EPS rose from $2.76 to $2.85 over 90 days with more upward than downward revisions.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Cloud growth is guided to decelerate from 31% to about 28.5%, making guidance the decisive test in a hostile software tape.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $1.71B revenue; company guide is $1.705B-$1.715B and 28.5% cloud growth.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Cloud growth and margin guidance repeat the prior-quarter upside surprise.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A routine beat with softer cloud or billings guidance fails a high bar.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options priced roughly 14%-15%; realized reactions have been large.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Prior Q4 revenue grew 28% and cloud 31%, leaving strong evidence on both sides.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong summer demand, fleet availability and hedging support results, but the power/AI factor selloff makes the guide two-sided.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus varies around $2.34-$2.98 EPS; guidance and Cogentrix/Meta visibility matter more.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Management raises or de-risks the 2027 EBITDA path.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: ERCOT curves, regulation or integration keep guidance conservative.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The stock fell sharply with AI-power names, raising both relief and continuation risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Revenue and EPS are expected to rise strongly, though the beat record is mixed.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AI product momentum and prior guide improvement create upside optionality, but bookings evidence is thin and options demand a major move.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $0.34-$0.36 EPS and $171M-$174M revenue.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Bookings and FY guidance validate AI-driven engagement.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Slow marketing-solutions demand or a flat guide disappoints.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Published option snapshots vary, with some readings near 19%-20%.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Prior report produced a large positive reaction despite a headline miss, underscoring guidance sensitivity.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Stable contracted cash flows and project execution support a mild upside lean, but the setup lacks a strong event catalyst.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS about $0.49; business update and acquisition financing matter.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Rate settlements and project execution support guidance.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Financing costs or regulatory delays offset stability.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Low-volatility profile limits both expected reaction and directional edge.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: No strong revision signal; this is primarily a stability setup.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Inventory normalization and sequential recovery support a mild upside lean, but the semiconductor selloff and forward guide dominate the event.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $0.94 EPS and $1.61B revenue, near management's $1.589B-$1.618B range.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Sell-through, utilization and December guidance improve.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Industrial/auto softness or margin guidance extends the sector rout.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The stock was down double digits intraday, sharply increasing squeeze risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Current-quarter estimates sit near the midpoint/high end of guidance.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: HPC revenue can ramp, but delivery timing, financing and a severe factor selloff make the direction too unstable.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Loss near $0.18; CB-4 rent commencement and capacity delivery dominate.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Faster rent commencement or a tenant update triggers relief.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Delay, cash burn or dilution pressure extends the selloff.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Retail/short-positioning sensitivity is high after a double-digit same-day drop.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Evidence supports higher HPC revenue but limited quarterly CB-4 contribution.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Higher oil and production support results, but the stock has repeatedly sold off after beats and acquisition debt keeps the reaction two-sided.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $4.45 EPS; production, capital returns and Encino debt are the key read.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Output and free cash flow beat while debt falls faster.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Capex or leverage commentary outweighs another EPS beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The last two EPS beats were followed by notable negative reactions.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Five straight EPS beats lower the headline-surprise value.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Revenue growth and magnet ramp progress are constructive, but the policy-sensitive narrative and weak near-term earnings quality prevent a clean edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Loss near $0.01-$0.02 on about $117M revenue.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Commercial magnet shipments and NdPr production exceed expectations.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Ramp costs, pricing or timeline slippage dominate.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Policy headlines and a sharp same-day decline make squeeze risk high.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Revenue is expected to more than double, but loss and ramp costs persist.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong large-customer and AI-security demand collide with decelerating growth, high valuation and an extreme pre-event selloff.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $0.34 EPS and $737M revenue; Q3 growth guidance was near 31%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Revenue, cRPO and large-customer adds repeat the Q2 upside.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Deceleration or margin/guidance concerns validate the derating.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options priced roughly 14%-15%; the stock fell about 11% intraday before reporting.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q2 revenue beat by about 4.7%, but the real bar is forward growth.
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Existing premium-growth expectation-bar and reversal-risk guardrails

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Quarterly earnings are secondary to licensing and deployment milestones, and the stock's collapse makes either-direction narrative gaps plausible.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Loss near $0.27; cash, NRC progress and customer milestones matter more.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: An accelerated regulatory or customer milestone resets the timeline.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Delay, higher cash burn or thin new detail disappoints.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Retail crowding and a double-digit same-day fall create very high reversal risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: No reliable operating-estimate revision signal; milestone evidence is sparse.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Contracted ARR is strong, but the report must prove delivery and revenue conversion amid severe AI-infrastructure de-risking.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Street models vary widely; Horizon revenue and Q4 delivery are decisive.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Revenue conversion and on-time Horizon 2-4 delivery validate financing.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Delay, lower EBITDA or funding concerns dominate.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The stock fell about 16% intraday, while retail sentiment remains polarized.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Analyst estimates are timing-sensitive because capacity ramps late in 2026.
